caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter that adapts this DM script to every lead. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: the DM script I made to book calls without sounding scripted.

1. Answer what they asked, price included. "Hop on a call first" is how you end up on "Seen".

2. Ask one question at a time, never two in the same message.

3. Check the fit (timing and budget), then offer two times instead of a link. On "I'll think about it", ask which part they're unsure about.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: he builds that script from your offer and adapts it to every lead, in your voice, through Manychat.

The catch: no script and no setter can promise you a number of calls. Building and testing Setty are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.

Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
